messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 - Metering anomaly detected in billing pipeline. Token ingestion lag + delta on aggregate counts (>8% drift). Auto-alert triggered by count-guard. Root TS: 1701239876
Maya Patel: seeing the same in dashboards. billing-count-agg shows token_count downstream lagging behind ingest by ~2.4M tokens in last 30m :eyes:
Devon Li: paging infra on-call (@Sachin Rao) — Sachin, you good to take?
Sachin Rao: taking it. oncall here. quick ask: is this a read-only drift or double-count?
Zoe Kim: customer side started getting overage flags for a subset of orgs 15m ago. CS flagged two customers.
Sachin Rao: ok triage plan: 1) pause billing emit to downstream consumers (soft pause) 2) enable diagnostic mode to capture raw token diffs 3) if drift grows, flip to fallback aggregator. I'll run commands.
Devon Li: :thumbsup: notify billing and CS now. tagging billing-team and cs-escalations.
Maya Patel: putting a suppress rule on overage alerts for impacted accounts to avoid noisy pages while we investigate (will annotate).
Ops-Bot: Command queued by @Sachin Rao: `infra meter pause-emit --scope=billing-prod --reason="investigating token drift"`
Sachin Rao: ran pause-emit. emit status: PAUSED. saving current window snapshot.
Sachin Rao: running quick checksum of Kafka->agg delta: ```
# quick delta check
kafka-consumer-group --describe --group billing-ingest
python tools/compare_counts.py --from=ingest --to=agg --window=30m
```
Maya Patel: logs show a spike of late retries from a worker shard around 1701239600, might explain duplicate reads after consumer rebalance.
Devon Li: any recent deploys to metering service? devex reported small config roll earlier today to consumer timeout.
Zoe Kim: yes, config-roll 1701238000 - changed `consumer.timeout_ms` from 30000 -> 45000 for better throughput. possible side effect?
Sachin Rao: hypothesis: extended timeout allowed duplicates to be processed during a brief rebalance causing double-counts and later compensating dedupe failing. Will enable agg dedupe snapshot and switch to fallback aggregator (stateless) to stop further drift.
Sachin Rao: command: `infra meter switch-aggregator --to=fallback-stateless --graceful=true`
Ops-Bot: switch accepted. draining active aggregators (graceful). estimated flip ETA ~2m.
Maya Patel: CS/Support update drafted: "We detected a metering telemetry issue affecting usage reporting for a subset of customers between approx 16:20 and 16:40 UTC. We have paused billing emits and are reconciling counts; no charges will be applied until reconciliation completes. We'll follow up within 1 hour." @Zoe please send when ready.
Zoe Kim: sent to affected accounts. got ack from two customers — they appreciate the heads up.
Sachin Rao: flip completed. fallback aggregator online. new emits resuming (paused window reconciled into staging). monitoring differences now trending down to <0.5% after switch.
Devon Li: good. any immediate rollback needed on the config roll?
Maya Patel: let's revert consumer.timeout back to 30000 in canary and observe 30m before wider rollback.
Sachin Rao: running backfill script to reconcile lost/double tokens. kicking off: ```
python backfill/reconcile.py --start=1701239400 --end=1701239800 --mode=dedup_and_fix --dry-run=false
```
Ops-Bot: backfill job started (job id: bf-1701239876). ETA ~22m. progress logs streaming to #ingest-ops.
Devon Li: escalating to billing-engineering to validate final charge adjustments post-recon. tagging @billing-engineering.
Maya Patel: creating an incident ticket and postmortem stub. owners: Sachin (incident lead), Maya (product liaison), Devon (runtime). follow-ups: reduce config change risk, add automatic dedupe during rebalance, tighten alert thresholds.
Zoe Kim: CS confirmed temporary suppression worked; customers won't be billed until recon complete. they'll want a final reconciliation email after postmortem.
Sachin Rao: backfill >50% done, deltas reducing. current drift 0.18%.
Devon Li: nice. moving to mitigation/monitoring phase. anyone else need to join call?
Maya Patel: I'll spin up a 30m bridge for postmortem notes.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 updated: status=mitigated, mitigation=switched aggregator & paused emits, owner=Sachin Rao, incident_ts=1701239876
Sachin Rao: marking on-call handoff to next rotation in 40m. leaving runbook notes in Confluence. will stay until backfill finishes.
Zoe Kim: copying CS with final template to send once billing sign-off.
Devon Li: thanks all. closing page when backfill completes and billing confirms adjustments. :white_check_mark:
